parts.zh: M: 我刚买了一台新搅拌机
M: 没错，这台是最先进的
W: 真的吗？它到底有什么特别的？我的意思是
M: 嗯，基本上，它就是一台非常好的搅拌机
W: 嗯，我明白了。我从来没想过自己也买一台
M: 我以前从来没有搅拌机
W: 我能想象那一定很令人满足
M: 健康多了，根本不是一个级别的

items.stem: What does the man say he did before buying the blender?

choices.text: Read numerous comments users put online.
choices.zh: 阅读了大量用户在网上发布的评论。

choices.text: Blended all his food without using a machine.
choices.zh: 不使用机器搅拌他所有的食物。

choices.text: Searched for the state-of-the-art models of blenders.
choices.zh: 搜索了最先进的搅拌机型号。

choices.text: Did thorough research on the price of kitchen appliances.
choices.zh: 对厨房电器的价格做了彻底的研究。

items.stem: What does the woman say she has never thought of doing?

choices.text: Eating any blended food.
choices.zh: 吃任何搅拌食品。

choices.text: Buying a blender herself.
choices.zh: 自己购买一台搅拌机。

choices.text: Using machines to do her cooking.
choices.zh: 使用机器来做饭。

choices.text: Making soups and juices for herself.
choices.zh: 自己制作汤和果汁。

items.stem: What does the man say is a really healthy habit?

choices.text: Cooking every meal creatively in the kitchen.
choices.zh: 在厨房里创意性地烹饪每一餐。

choices.text: Paying due attention to his personal hygiene.
choices.zh: 适当关注他的个人卫生。

choices.text: Eating breakfast punctually every morning.
choices.zh: 每天早上准时吃早餐。

choices.text: Making his own fresh fruit juice regularly.
choices.zh: 定期自制新鲜果汁。

items.stem: What do we learn about store-bought juice from the conversation?

choices.text: One-tenth of it is sugar.
choices.zh: 其中十分之一是糖。

choices.text: It looks healthy and attractive.
choices.zh: 它看起来健康且有吸引力。

choices.text: One's fancy may be tickled by it.
choices.zh: 它可能会引起人们的兴趣。

choices.text: It contains an assortment of nutrients.
choices.zh: 它包含各种营养成分。

items.stem: What is the question the woman asked Mr. Grimm after the introduction?

choices.text: How he has made himself popular as the mayor of Berkton.
choices.zh: 他如何使自己成为广受欢迎的Berkton市长。

choices.text: How the residents will turn Berkton into a tourist attraction.
choices.zh: 居民将如何把Berkton变成旅游胜地。

choices.text: How charming he himself considers the village of Berkton to be.
choices.zh: 他本人认为Berkton村有多迷人。

choices.text: How he has led people of Berkton to change the village radically.
choices.zh: 他如何带领Berkton的人们彻底改变了这个村庄。

items.stem: What do we learn about Berkton 10 years ago?

choices.text: It was developed only to a limited extent.
choices.zh: 它的开发程度很有限。

choices.text: It was totally isolated as a sleepy village.
choices.zh: 它完全与世隔绝,是个沉睡的村庄。

choices.text: It was relatively unknown to the outside.
choices.zh: 它在外界相对不为人知。

choices.text: It was endowed with rare natural resources.
choices.zh: 它拥有稀有的自然资源。

items.stem: What resulted from the passing of the legislative proposal "Motion 836"?

choices.text: All the properties in Berkton were designed by the same architect.
choices.zh: Berkton的所有房产都由同一位建筑师设计。

choices.text: The majority of residents lived in harmony with their neighbours.
choices.zh: 大多数居民与邻居和睦相处。

choices.text: The majority of residents enjoyed cosy housing conditions.
choices.zh: 大多数居民享有舒适的住房条件。

choices.text: All the houses in Berkton looked aesthetically similar.
choices.zh: Berkton的所有房屋在美学上看起来相似。

items.stem: Why does the man say the tourists are a blessing to Berkton?

choices.text: They have helped boost the local economy.
choices.zh: 他们帮助促进了当地经济。

choices.text: They have made the residents unusually proud.
choices.zh: 他们使居民感到异常自豪。

choices.text: They have contributed considerably to its popularity.
choices.zh: 他们为其知名度做出了相当大的贡献。

choices.text: They have brought happiness to everyone in the village.
choices.zh: 他们给村里的每个人都带来了快乐。

items.stem: What does the passage say about a team of researchers at Northwestern University?

choices.text: They have created the smallest remote-controlled walking robot in the world.
choices.zh: 他们创造了世界上最小的遥控行走机器人。

choices.text: They are going to publish their research findings in the journal Science Robotics.
choices.zh: 他们将在《Science Robotics》期刊上发表他们的研究成果。

choices.text: They are the first to build a robot that can bend, crawl, walk, turn and even jump.
choices.zh: 他们是第一个制造出能够弯曲、爬行、行走、转弯甚至跳跃的机器人的团队。

choices.text: They are engaged in research on a remote-controlled robot which uses special power.
choices.zh: 他们正从事一种使用特殊动力的遥控机器人的研究。

items.stem: What did the researchers say about the robot they created?

choices.text: It changes its shape by complex hardware.
choices.zh: 它通过复杂的硬件改变形状。

choices.text: It is operated by a special type of tiny motor.
choices.zh: 它由一种特殊类型的微型马达操作。

choices.text: It moves from one place to another by memory.
choices.zh: 它通过记忆从一个地方移动到另一个地方。

choices.text: It is powered by the elastic property of its body.
choices.zh: 它由其身体的弹性特性提供动力。

items.stem: What do the researchers expect their robots to do in the future?

choices.text: Replace humans in exploratory tasks.
choices.zh: 在探索性任务中取代人类。

choices.text: Perform tasks in tightly confined spaces.
choices.zh: 在狭小密闭的空间中执行任务。

choices.text: Explore the structure of clogged arteries.
choices.zh: 探索堵塞动脉的结构。

choices.text: Assist surgeons in highly complex surgery.
choices.zh: 在高度复杂的手术中协助外科医生。

items.stem: What does the speaker say she did on her ride to the Isles of Scilly?

choices.text: She threw up in the bathroom.
choices.zh: 她在浴室里呕吐了。

choices.text: She slept during the entire ride.
choices.zh: 她在整个行程中都在睡觉。

choices.text: She dozed off for a few minutes.
choices.zh: 她打了几分钟瞌睡。

choices.text: She boasted of her marathon race.
choices.zh: 她吹嘘自己的马拉松比赛。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about elite sleepers?

choices.text: They are mostly immune to cognitive impairment.
choices.zh: 他们大多对认知障碍免疫。

choices.text: They can sleep soundly during a rough ride at sea.
choices.zh: 他们能在海上颠簸的行程中安然入睡。

choices.text: They are genetically determined to need less sleep.
choices.zh: 他们在基因上被决定需要更少的睡眠。

choices.text: They constitute about 13 percent of the population.
choices.zh: 他们约占人口的百分之十三。

items.stem: What has the speaker been trying to find out over the past year?

choices.text: Whether there is a way to reach elite status.
choices.zh: 是否有办法达到精英睡眠者的状态。

choices.text: Whether it is possible to modify one's genes.
choices.zh: 是否有可能改变一个人的基因。

choices.text: Whether having a baby impacts one's passion.
choices.zh: 生孩子是否会影响一个人的热情。

choices.text: Whether one can train themselves to sleep less.
choices.zh: 一个人是否能训练自己少睡觉。

items.stem: What has the speaker discovered after a year of tough scientific study?

choices.text: It is in fact quite possible to nurture a passion for sleep.
choices.zh: 事实上完全有可能培养对睡眠的热情。

choices.text: Babies can severely disrupt their parents' sleep patterns.
choices.zh: 婴儿会严重扰乱父母的睡眠模式。

choices.text: Being forced to rise early differs from being an early bird.
choices.zh: 被迫早起不同于成为早起的人。

choices.text: New parents are forced to jump out of bed at the crack of dawn.
choices.zh: 新手父母被迫在破晓时分跳下床。

items.stem: What does a new paper in the *Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology* suggest?

choices.text: We have poor awareness of how many controversial issues are being debated.
choices.zh: 我们对有多少争议性问题正在被讨论缺乏认识。

choices.text: No one knows better than yourself what you are thinking about at the moment.
choices.zh: 没有人比你自己更清楚此刻你在想什么。

choices.text: No one can change your opinions more than those who speak in a convincing tone.
choices.zh: 没有人能比那些以令人信服的语气说话的人更能改变你的观点。

choices.text: We are likely to underestimate how much we can be swayed by a convincing article.
choices.zh: 我们可能低估了自己会在多大程度上被一篇有说服力的文章所影响。

items.stem: What happened when the students read a text that argued against their own initial position?

choices.text: Their belief about physical punishment changed.
choices.zh: 他们对体罚的看法改变了。

choices.text: Their memory pushed them toward a current belief.
choices.zh: 他们的记忆将他们推向了当前的信念。

choices.text: The memory of their initial belief came back to them.
choices.zh: 他们对最初信念的记忆回到了他们脑海中。

choices.text: Their experiences of physical punishment haunted them.
choices.zh: 他们遭受体罚的经历困扰着他们。

items.stem: What did the researchers concede concerning their findings?

choices.text: They apparently have little to do with moderate beliefs.
choices.zh: 这些结果显然与温和的信念关系不大。

choices.text: They don't reflect the change of view on physical punishment.
choices.zh: 这些结果没有反映出对体罚看法的变化。

choices.text: They may not apply to changes to extreme or deeply held beliefs.
choices.zh: 这些结果可能不适用于极端或根深蒂固的信念的改变。

choices.text: They are unlikely to alter people's position without more evidence.
choices.zh: 如果没有更多证据,这些结果不太可能改变人们的立场。

items.stem: What does the speaker conclude from her analysis of the Census Bureau's data?

choices.text: American moms have been increasingly inclined to live alone.
choices.zh: 美国母亲越来越倾向于独自生活。

choices.text: The American population has been on the rise in the past 25 years.
choices.zh: 过去25年美国人口一直在增长。

choices.text: American motherhood has actually been on the decline.
choices.zh: 美国母亲身份实际上一直在减少。

choices.text: The fertility rates in America have in fact been falling sharply.
choices.zh: 美国的生育率实际上一直在急剧下降。

items.stem: What does the speaker say is a positive consequence of the age shift in childbearing?

choices.text: More new mothers tend to take greater care of their children.
choices.zh: 更多新手母亲倾向于更悉心照顾她们的孩子。

choices.text: More new mothers are economically able to raise children.
choices.zh: 更多新手母亲在经济上有能力抚养孩子。

choices.text: A larger proportion of women take pride in their children.
choices.zh: 更大比例的女性为她们的孩子感到自豪。

choices.text: A larger proportion of women really enjoy motherhood.
choices.zh: 更大比例的女性真正享受母亲身份。

items.stem: What might be one explanation for the rise in retail spending on Mother's Day?

choices.text: The meaning of motherhood has changed considerably.
choices.zh: 母亲身份的含义已经发生了相当大的变化。

choices.text: More and more mothers go shopping to treat themselves.
choices.zh: 越来越多的母亲去购物犒劳自己。

choices.text: More mothers have adult children celebrating the holiday.
choices.zh: 更多母亲有成年子女庆祝这个节日。

choices.text: The number of American mothers has been growing steadily.
choices.zh: 美国母亲的数量一直在稳步增长。

items.stem: What does NASA's 1989 paper claim houseplants can do?

choices.text: A) Add to indoor toxic pollutants.
choices.zh: 增加室内有毒污染物。

choices.text: Absorb poisonous chemicals.
choices.zh: 吸收有毒化学物质。

choices.text: Beautify the home environment.
choices.zh: 美化家居环境。

choices.text: Soak up surrounding moisture.
choices.zh: 吸收周围湿气。

items.stem: What is said to be the problem with NASA's study reported in its 1989 paper?

choices.text: NASA did experiments in sealed containers resembling the super insulated offices of 1970s.
choices.zh: NASA在类似1970年代超级隔热办公室的密封容器中进行了实验。

choices.text: It was based on experiments under conditions unlike those in most homes or offices.
choices.zh: 该研究基于与大多数家庭或办公室条件不同的实验。

choices.text: NASA conducted tests in outer space whose environment is different from ours.
choices.zh: NASA在外太空进行了测试,其环境与我们的环境不同。

choices.text: It drew its conclusion without any contrastive data from other experiments.
choices.zh: 该研究在没有其他实验对比数据的情况下得出了结论。

items.stem: What is the finding of a new evaluation of dozens of studies spanning 30 years?

choices.text: Natural ventilation proves much more efficient for cleaning the air than houseplants.
choices.zh: 自然通风在清洁空气方面比室内植物有效得多。

choices.text: Houseplants disperse chemical compounds more quickly with people moving around.
choices.zh: 随着人员走动,室内植物更快地散发化学化合物。

choices.text: Natural ventilation turns out to be most effective with doors and windows wide open.
choices.zh: 自然通风在门窗大开时最为有效。

choices.text: Houseplants in a normal environment rarely have any adverse impact on the air.
choices.zh: 正常环境中的室内植物很少对空气产生任何不良影响。

items.stem: What does NASA's sealed experiment recommendation exemplify in scientists' pursuit of truth?

choices.text: The root cause for misinterpretations of scientific findings.
choices.zh: 科学发现被误读的根本原因。

choices.text: The difficulty in understanding what's actually happening.
choices.zh: 理解实际发生情况的难度。

choices.text: The steps to be taken in arriving at any conclusion with certainty.
choices.zh: 确定无疑地得出任何结论所需采取的步骤。

choices.text: The necessity of continually reexamining and challenging findings.
choices.zh: 不断重新审查和质疑研究发现的必要性。
